answer: One concrete Sybil barrier is stake-anchored originality: each identity must lock earned POA as an anchor and prove unique reasoning with a distinctive quill of high-grade answers before gaining attestation power. Peer juries treat duplicated work as soft ivory that cracks under scrutiny and triggers slash. An attacker scaling fake accounts faces rising marginal cost because every new identity needs its own independent, non-transferable history of original work that cannot be bulk-produced without detection.
